Password::defaults(min 8, letters, mixedCase, numbers) at app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:30; MustVerifyEmail at app/Models/User.php:15; locale pins at .env.example:1,9 and phpunit.xml:22-23. security.evidence: Constant-time id and e-mail-hash checks plus 403 on mismatch (app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:12,16); session regeneration on login (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:47) and logout (app/Http/Controllers/LogoutController.php:15-16); remember_token rotated on reset (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:38); rate limits on login (Login.php:31) and register (Register.php:28). Gap: Register's public input properties carry no #[Validate] or rules() method (Register.php:18-21), violating Livewire policy rule 1 even though validate() is called inline at :36; no unescaped output or trusted client IDs found.

tests.evidence: The diff adds no test file at all; the only test-file hunk is tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php:3, which just drops an unused RefreshDatabase import. None of the login, register, throttling, forgot/reset, verification or locale requirements has a Pest/PHPUnit test, and the required unauthorized-call/tamper tests for the Livewire actions are absent.

issues.location: tests/ (no new test files in change.diff; only tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php:3 changed)
issues.explanation: An entire authentication system ships with zero tests, breaking the project's test-first rule and the definition of done, which additionally demands unauthorized-call and tamper tests for every Livewire action.

The resend flow flashes and prints the raw machine string 'verification-link-sent', so the user sees that literal text instead of translated copy, directly violating the requirement that all screen text come from the lang files.

Register's public input properties have neither #[Validate] attributes nor a rules() method, so the component violates Livewire policy rule 1 as enforced in this project, even though validate() is called inline.
The verification notice displays ui.logged_in ("Você está logado!"), which is misleading copy for a page asking the user to verify their e-mail and omits any explanation of what to do.
The reset flow redirects to login with a status flash, but the Livewire login view never renders session('status'), so the user receives no confirmation that the password was changed.

RateLimiter::hit() runs before validation and is never cleared on success, so validation failures and successful registrations consume the 5-attempt IP budget, blocking a sixth registration within the decay window.
Three fields are validated inline, while the convention reserves inline validation for one or two fields and asks for a Form Request beyond that.
The new auth routes, flow and locale defaults are not documented and CHANGELOG has no [Unreleased] entry, contrary to the keep-docs-in-sync convention.

issues.location: bootstrap/providers.php:3-9; lang/pt_BR/auth.php:20, pagination.php:19, passwords.php:22, validation.php:200; tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php:3
issues.explanation: Unrelated cleanups (import rewrite, trailing-newline fixes, unused import removal) are bundled into the auth change and add review noise.
password_confirmation and confirm_password are duplicate keys with the same value in both locales; one key would suffice.
The layout outputs both {{ $slot ?? '' }} and @yield('content') so one file serves Livewire layouts and @extends views; it works but is surprising and easy to break.

review.summary: The change implements the full session-auth surface (Livewire login/register, logout, password reset, signed e-mail verification, locale pins and translation files) and is mostly readable and security-conscious. It is not approvable yet: no tests ship with any of the new behaviour, the verification resend flashes an untranslated machine string, and Register skips the project-mandated #[Validate]/rules() pattern. The unrelated cleanups and missing docs add to the need for rework.
